risk_note: B1-13n (owner's consent 2026-11-22, ruling D10-2636 ②; precedent B1-02zza): staging test identity for the two-element real-name check. Only with APP_ENV=staging and STAGING_TEST_REALNAME_USER_IDS (comma-separated, 1-10 lowercase UUIDs, refused at startup when malformed or when set outside staging) does the member-side verifier answer match for a listed user_id, with provider staging-test-identity and one audit line (event staging_test_realname_verified; app_id, user_id, provider; fixed message, emitted by an info-level child logger so LOG_LEVEL cannot filter it). Unlisted users and every other environment answer as before (50301, not counted); every pre-check (consent, format, check digit, age line, occupancy 30405) is unchanged; the admin real-name correction keeps createRealnameVerifier. An idempotent replay of a kept staging-test-identity match is re-judged against the current environment and list (no longer honoured: 50301, nothing written, count and mark untouched). Name and ID number never reach a log, an audit line or an error. This changes BR-ID-25 'no vendor answer is faked outside local / test' by the owner's consent; the planning write-back is on the orchestrator's pending list.
